headline: Executive order directing federal action to help collect overdue child support payments.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with collecting child support that parents owe but have not paid. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Parents who owe overdue child support
who_it_affects.how: They may face federal efforts to collect the money they owe.

who_it_affects.group: Parents and children who are owed child support
who_it_affects.how: They may receive overdue payments collected through these efforts.
They are likely directed to take part in collecting overdue child support.
